errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not sorted alphabetically. The order is "Общо за страната", "Северозападен...", "Видин", "Враца", "Ловеч", "Монтана", "Плевен". An alphabetical order in Bulgarian would start with "Видин".
The description incorrectly identifies the first category as "Общ Област". The correct label on the chart is "Общо за страната" (Total for the country).

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос показва стойности в хиляди левове (хвл.)
errors.evidence: The y-axis is labeled "лв." (BGN), and the values are shown as 100,000 and 200,000, not in thousands of BGN. The description incorrectly states the unit is "thousands of BGN".
The major tick mark on the y-axis is at 100,000. There are 10 gridlines between 0 and 100,000, meaning the interval for the minor gridlines is 10,000, not 20,000.

errors.text_span: за 2016 година, Общ Област има стойност около 60,000 хвл.
errors.evidence: The value for the first category ("Общо за страната") in 2016 (blue bar) is just under 100,000, approximately 95,000. The reported value of 60,000 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: докато за 2019 година Плевен има стойност около 180,000 хвл.
errors.evidence: The value for "Плевен" in 2019 (purple bar) is extremely low, barely visible on the chart and likely in the low thousands. The reported value of 180,000 is a massive overestimation and does not reflect the data in the chart at all.
The chart is a grouped bar chart. For each region on the x-axis, the bars for the four years (2016-2019) are clustered together. The description incorrectly states that there is no grouping.

The description fails to mention the most prominent visual feature of the chart: the vast difference in magnitude between the GDP for "Общо за страната" (Total for the country) and all the other individual regions, whose bars are comparatively tiny.
